title: Communication Dated 11.12.36 From The British Consulate-General Concerning A.A. Gossevsky

page_data.en:
LCC
G. 43M-1-36

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. D. 7671
S.I, Special Branch. SECTION, 24 12 36
REPORT
Date December 23, 1936.

Subject Communication dated 11/12/36 from the British Consulate-General
concerning A.A. Gossevsky.

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev Forwarded by [Signature] 653

Alexis Alexander Gossevsky, naturalized British subject,
of Russian origin, was born on July 28, 1893 at St. Petersburg
(now Leningrad). Former artillery officer of the Russian
Imperial Army he is reported to have seen active service
during the Great War. In 1918-1920 during the civil war in
Russia he fought in the ranks of Admiral Kolchak's army in
Siberia. Following the defeat of the "Whites" in 1920 Gossevsky
together with the remainder of Ataman Annenkov's detachment
found his way to Singkiang Province, China, where the detachment
was interned by the Chinese authorities. Later during the same
year he proceeded to Peking and subsequently resided in Tientsin
where he is reported to have been employed with a local firm
dealing in furs. While in Tientsin he married Miss T.A.
Froloff, daughter of a former officer of the Russian Army.

In 1926 he arrived in Shanghai from Tientsin and resided
in this city until 1929. Here he was employed first with the
West Coast Life Insurance Co. and later joined the Asia Life
Insurance Co. It is reported that on behalf of the latter
Company he visited Hongkong, Saigon, Haiphong and Hanoi.
At present he is manager of the Singapore branch of the company.
It appears that it was during the period of his residence in
Singapore that he became a British subject.

On March 13, 1936 Gossevsky who together with his family
was proceeding to the United States on long leave arrived in
Shanghai from Singapore in the s.s. SHARNHORST. From the Alien
Passport Declaration Form he filled up prior to the disembarka-
tion it appears that he holds British passport No.13404 issued
on 29/1/36 at Singapore. He gave his home address as 3 Leonie
Hill, Singapore, and as references in Shanghai mentioned

特别处，S.I 科，1936年12月24日
报告
日期：1936年12月23日。

事由：英国总领事馆于1936年12月11日来函，涉及 A.A. Gossevsky。

由特别调查员 Prokofiev 撰写 转呈人 [签名] 653

Alexis Alexander Gossevsky，归化英国臣民，
俄裔，1893年7月28日出生于圣彼得堡
（现列宁格勒）。他曾是俄罗斯
帝国陆军的炮兵军官，据报在
第一次世界大战期间服役于前线。1918-1920年
俄罗斯内战期间，他在西伯利亚的
高尔察克海军上将军队中作战。1920年“白军”
战败后，Gossevsky 随阿塔曼 Annenkov 支队的
余部辗转至中国新疆省，该支队被
中国当局拘禁。同年晚些时候，他前往
北京，随后居住于天津，据报受雇于当地一家
皮草商行。在天津期间，他娶了 T.A.
Froloff 小姐为妻，后者系一名前俄罗斯陆军军官之女。

1926年，他从天津抵达上海，并在此
居住至1929年。在此期间，他先受雇于
西海岸人寿保险公司（West Coast Life Insurance Co.），
后加入亚洲人寿保险公司（Asia Life
Insurance Co.）。据报，他曾代表后者公司
访问香港、西贡、海防和河内。
目前，他是该公司新加坡分行的经理。
看来，他正是在新加坡居住期间
成为英国臣民的。

1936年3月13日，Gossevsky 携家人
乘长期休假之机，乘坐“沙恩霍斯特”号轮船
（s.s. SHARNHORST）从新加坡抵达上海。从他
下船前填写的外侨护照申报表中可以看出，
他持有1936年1月29日在新加坡签发的
第13404号英国护照。他提供的住址为新加坡
利奥尼山3号（3 Leonie Hill, Singapore），在上海的
推荐人提及

Messrs A.M. Wolynsky, of the International Assurance Co. and
T.F. Richardson of the United States Life Insurance Co., 17 The
Bund. On March 26 he left for Los Angeles in the s.s. "President
Coolidge." On his return trip to Singapore he paid another
short visit to Shanghai, arriving here on August 24 in the
s.s. "President Coolidge" and leaving on September 15 in the
s.s. "Chitral."

Gossevsky's sister is married to an Englishman (particulars
of name etc. not available) while his sister-in-law is married
to a Russian named A.A. Essen, who is employed with Chinese
Maritime Customs as a light-house keeper.

It is reported that while in Singapore some time ago
Gossevsky made the acquaintance of a certain Russian of Georgian
origin named J.N. Bebour-Vachnadze, who was sentenced to 6 months'
imprisonment in Shanghai recently for fraud. It appears that
Gossevsky introduced the latter individual to certain residents
of Singapore and that he has every reason to regret it. At
least, during one of his recent visits to Shanghai, he refused to
see Bebour-Vachnadze who was anxious to pay him a visit.

Enquiries regarding his antecedents prior to his coming
to Shanghai do not elicit any information which could reflect
adversely on his character. While in Shanghai he did not come
to the notice of the Municipal Police in connection with any
activities of an undesirable nature. He was member of the Rus-
sian Ex-Officers' Club in Shanghai. Several persons of good
standing in the local Russian community, who knew Gossevsky
personally, describe him as a respectable person of good family
and education.

（批：D.B.R. 24/12）

G. Prokofiev
D.S.I.

D.C. (Special Branch).

国际保证公司（International Assurance Co.）的 A.M. Wolynsky 先生，以及
外滩17号美国人寿保险公司（United States Life Insurance Co.）的
T.F. Richardson 先生。3月26日，他乘坐“柯立芝总统”号轮船
（s.s. "President Coolidge"）前往洛杉矶。在返回
新加坡的途中，他又短暂访问了上海，于8月24日
乘坐“柯立芝总统”号轮船抵达此处，并于9月15日
乘坐“奇特拉尔”号轮船（s.s. "Chitral"）离开。

Gossevsky 的妹妹嫁给了一位英国人（姓名等
详情不详），而他的嫂子弟媳则嫁给了一位名为
A.A. Essen 的俄国人，后者受雇于中国海关，
担任灯塔看守人。

据报，Gossevsky 不久前在新加坡时
结识了一位格鲁吉亚裔俄国人 J.N. Bebour-Vachnadze，
此人最近因欺诈罪在上海被判处六个月
监禁。看来是 Gossevsky 将此人介绍给了新加坡的
某些居民，而他完全有理由为此感到后悔。至少，
在他最近一次访问上海期间，他拒绝会见急于
拜访他的 Bebour-Vachnadze。

关于他来上海之前的经历，调查并未发现
任何可能对其品格产生负面影响的资料。在上海
期间，他未因任何不良性质的活动引起
工部局警务处的注意。他是上海俄罗斯
前军官俱乐部的成员。几位在当地俄罗斯社区中
地位良好且 personally 认识 Gossevsky 的人士，
形容他是一位出身良好、受过良好教育且
体面的人。

（批注：D.B.R. 12月24日）

G. Prokofiev
特别调查员

副警务处长（特别处）。

BRITISH CONSULATE-GENERAL,
P.O. BOX 259. SHANGHAI.

11. 12. 36.

My dear Bourne,

The Asia Life Insurance Co., 17 The Bund, has
a branch office in Singapore in charge of a Russian named
A. A. GOSSEVSKY.

I have nothing definite against this man but
would be most grateful for any information which may be
obtainable here about his history prior to his joining the
company (which I believe he did about 6 - 7 years ago).

I am particularly anxious that my enquiries
should not in any way harm the man vis a vis his firm.

Yours Sincerely,
H Wupwe
P.A

Major K. M. Bourne M.C.,
Deputy Commissioner of Police,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
Foochow Road.

英国总领事馆，
邮政信箱259号，上海。

1936年12月11日。

亲爱的 Bourne：

位于外滩17号的亚洲人寿保险公司在
新加坡设有一家分行，由一名名为
A. A. GOSSEVSKY 的俄国人负责。

我对这个人没有确凿的不利指控，但
若能提供他在加入该公司之前（据信约为
6-7年前）的任何履历信息，我将不胜感激。

我特别希望我的查询不要以任何方式
损害他在其公司眼中的形象。

此致
敬礼，
H Wupwe
私人助理

K. M. Bourne 少校，MC勋衔，
副警务处长，
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
福州路。
